description: Operational checklist intended for CI/CD policy enforcement, release review, and governance sign-off. The project remains plan-only and does not execute live cloud or runtime actions automatically.

gates.description: Artifact is signed with a trusted identity and verified before release.
Provenance and attestation are reviewed and match the expected source revision.
SBOM is generated for the release artifact and retained as evidence.
Component vulnerabilities are mapped to CVE feeds and reviewed against policy thresholds.
Runtime and workload controls are reviewed against the deployment profile.
Security, compliance, and release ownership approve the production promotion.

rules: exception must have an accountable owner
compensating control must be explicitly documented
risk must be reviewed before promotion

sbom_recommendation.cyclonedx: preferred for engineering automation, release correlation, and machine-readable dependency risk analysis
sbom_recommendation.spdx: preferred for compliance and legal reporting
sbom_recommendation.hybrid_policy: generate both formats when the release is intended for broad compliance and operational review

notes: This checklist is a governance template; it does not replace operator validation or environment-specific controls.
The repository intentionally models cloud/runtime actions as plan-only and non-executing by design.
